A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Linoleic Acid

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Linoleic Acid
data_LA <- read.csv("LA.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_LA$Mean <- as.numeric(data_LA$Mean)
data_LA$SD <- as.numeric(data_LA$SD)
data_LA$Sample <- as.numeric(data_LA$Sample)
data_LA$Age <- as.numeric(data_LA$Age)
data_LA$Weight <- as.numeric(data_LA$Weight)
data_LA$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_LA$Digestible_energy)
data_LA$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_LA$Crude_protein)
data_LA$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_LA$Crude_fat)
data_LA$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_LA$Crude_fiber)
data_LA$Ash <- as.numeric(data_LA$Ash)
data_LA$Lys <- as.numeric(data_LA$Lys)
data_LA$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_LA$Met_and_Cys)
data_LA$Thr <- as.numeric(data_LA$Thr)
data_LA$Try <- as.numeric(data_LA$Try)
data_LA$Val <- as.numeric(data_LA$Val)
data_LA$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_LA$Dry_matter)
data_LA$Ca <- as.numeric(data_LA$Ca)
data_LA$P <- as.numeric(data_LA$P)
data_LA$Na <- as.numeric(data_LA$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_LA$Position <- factor(data_LA$Position)
data_LA$Breed <- factor(data_LA$Breed)
data_LA$Class <- factor(data_LA$Class)
data_LA$Sex <- factor(data_LA$Sex)
data_LA$Region <- factor(data_LA$Region) 
data_LA$Aim <- factor(data_LA$Aim)
data_LA$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_LA$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_LA$rVar <- (data_LA$SD/sqrt(data_LA$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_LA_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_LA, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_LA_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_LA, method = "ML")
summary(null_LA_mod) #2587.4295              
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 460; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1290.7147   2593.1408   2587.4295   2599.8232   2587.4821   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   4.1087  2.0270    460     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  31.7994  5.6391    222     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 459) = 4312156.1824, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  11.0623  0.3995  27.6908  <.0001  10.2793  11.8453  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_LA_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region), 
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_LA, method = "ML")
summary(Re_LA_mod) #2580.2653            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 460; method: ML)
##

## 
## Variance Components:
##

## sigma^2.2  27.0082  5.1969    222     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   5.0960  2.2574     47     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 459) = 4312156.1824, p-val < .0001

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
LA_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_LA, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(LA_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(LA_full_mod,null_LA_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik      LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    178 2552.4388 3287.7971 2779.2146 -1098.2194                   35193.4527 
## Reduced   3 2587.4295 2599.8232 2587.4821 -1290.7147 384.9907 <.0001 4312156.1824
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
LA_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_LA, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(LA_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(LA_Position_mod,null_LA_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    13 2586.0737 2639.7796 2586.8898 -1280.0368                4182596.9978 
## Reduced  3 2587.4295 2599.8232 2587.4821 -1290.7147 21.3558 0.0187 4312156.1824
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
LA_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData,

R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(LA_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(LA_Breed_mod,null_LA_mod)

## Model with Region as a fixed effect
LA_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(LA_Region_mod)*100, 2)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
LA_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(LA_Class_mod)*100, 2)

## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region", 
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1], 
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_LA_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,  
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      ~1 |Position), 
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_LA, method = "REML")
summary(REML_LA_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 460; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1266.2230   2532.4459   2544.4459   2569.2202   2544.6318   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1   2.9227  1.7096    460     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  25.2701  5.0269    222     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   5.6034  2.3671     47     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4   2.0177  1.4204    124     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5   1.3221  1.1498     11     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 459) = 4312156.1824, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  11.3671  0.7801  14.5714  <.0001  9.8381  12.8960  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_LA_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID   I2_Region    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##       99.99        7.87       68.04       15.09        5.43        3.56
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_LA_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          92.13
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_LA <- orchard_plot(REML_LA_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Linoleic Acid (%)", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_LA)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_LA_B3 <- data_LA %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_LA_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_LA_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region,  
                               ~1 |Position) 

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_LA_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_LA_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 315; method: REML)
##

# Model without intercept for plotting
Br_VCV_REML_LA_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_LA_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed -1,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_LA_B3)
## Orchard plot for Breed moderator
p_Br_VCV_REML_LA <- orchard_plot(Br_VCV_REML_LA_mod, 
                                  mod = "Breed",  
                                  group = "StudyID",  
                                  xlab = "Mean Linoleic Acid (%)", 
                                  cb = FALSE,
                                  angle = 0,
                                  legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                  branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Br_VCV_REML_LA)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_LA_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_LA_B3,
  vcv         = VCV_LA_B3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed 
)

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_LA_Cl <- data_LA %>%

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_LA_Age <- data_LA[complete.cases(data_LA$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_LA_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_LA_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,  
                                    ~1 |Breed, 
                                    ~1 |Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_LA_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_LA_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_LA_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Mean Linoleic Acid (%)" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_LA_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_LA_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_LA_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_LA_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed, 
                            ~1 |Position)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_LA)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 460; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1261.7286   2523.4573   2537.4573   2566.3454   2537.7062   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1   2.9235  1.7098    460     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  24.9748  4.9975    222     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   5.7005  2.3876     47     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4   2.0152  1.4196    124     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5   1.3131  1.1459     11     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 458) = 3237594.8287, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 458) = 3.0332, p-val = 0.0822
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##           estimate        se     tval   df    pval      ci.lb    ci.ub    
## intrcpt  -442.2929  260.4826  -1.6980  458  0.0902  -954.1822  69.5964  . 
## Years       0.2247    0.1290   1.7416  458  0.0822    -0.0288   0.4782  . 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           1.10          92.17
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_LA <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Linoleic Acid (%)", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_LA <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_LA + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_LA)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure
random_structure_aim <- list(~1 |RowID,
                             ~1 |StudyID,
                             ~1 |Region,  
                             ~1 |Breed,
                             ~1 |Position)

#Model with intercept
Ai_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_LA)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 460; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1263.0370   2526.0740   2540.0740   2568.9621   2540.3229   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1   2.9225  1.7095    460     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  25.3074  5.0306    222     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   5.7959  2.4075     47     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4   2.0186  1.4208    124     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5   1.3562  1.1646     11     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 458) = 1527596.8962, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 458) = 0.1052, p-val = 0.7458
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
## intrcpt   11.5702  0.9961  11.6158  458  <.0001   9.6128  13.5276  *** 
## AimYes    -0.2999  0.9248  -0.3243  458  0.7458  -2.1173   1.5174      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ai_VCV_REML_LA_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.05          92.19
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_LA_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_LA)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_LA <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_LA_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Linoleic Acid (%)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_LA)

#Model without intercept for plotting
Mu_VCV_REML_LA_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_LA_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds -1,
   random = random_structure_Mu, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_LA)
## Orchard plot for Multiple_breeds moderator
p_Mu_VCV_REML_LA <- orchard_plot(Mu_VCV_REML_LA_mod, 
                                   mod = "Multiple_breeds",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Linoleic Acid (%)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Mu_VCV_REML_LA)
